measured.on: the SAP sandbox (ABAP release 758), as a client, through RFC-enabled probe modules of our own; every object deleted afterwards

flags.X_K1: fill K1 with its initial value literally
flags.X_K2: fill K2 with its initial value literally

owners.O1: the calling session: a stateful RFC connection; its locks outlive each call on that connection
owners.O2: a second session: synchronous CALL FUNCTION ... DESTINATION 'NONE' from O1; stateful until RFC_CONNECTION_CLOSE
owners.O3: a third session: CALL FUNCTION ... STARTING NEW TASK ... DESTINATION 'NONE'; lives until the called module returns
owners.OJ: a background job: SUBMIT ... VIA JOB + JOB_CLOSE strtimmed
owners.model: a session has two owner ids. GUSR (dialog owner) holds _SCOPE 1 and lives as long as the session; GUSRVB (update owner) holds _SCOPE 2 and is replaced after a ROLLBACK WORK and after a COMMIT WORK that ran an update. _SCOPE 3 is one row carrying both. In expect, GUSR/GUSRVB name the session whose owner id it is; null = blank.

notation.\uffff: ENQUEUE_READ returns U+FFFF in every character position of a field that was locked generically (initial value, X_<field> not set)
notation.GARG: client + K1 (10) + K2 (10); trailing blanks are not significant
notation.<USER>: the user name of the holder (sy-msgv1); all sessions ran as one user
notation.K2: an ENQUEUE step without K2 in the case text uses K2='K'; an empty K2 is the initial value
notation.rows: ENQUEUE_READ (GNAME = 'ZOSD_PRB', GUNAME = space); row order is not part of the contract
notation.MC 601 / 602: 601 = held by another owner, 602 = refused against the caller's own lock; both raise FOREIGN_LOCK with sy-msgv1 = the user

enqueueRead.ownerId: 58 characters: a 20-digit timestamp (YYYYMMDDhhmmss + 6 digits), 4 digits, 2 digits, then the application server instance name, padded with '.'. Compare for equality only; do not parse.
